best_for: Developers and DBAs who work with several SQL databases and want a free, open-source client, and who can live without the NoSQL, cloud and AI extras of the paid editions.

points.title: Community is free and open
points.text: This is DBeaver Community, released under the Apache-2.0 license, with no account or license key needed. It is the free base that the paid PRO editions build on.

points.title: What PRO adds
points.text: The paid editions add MongoDB and other NoSQL and cloud databases, an AI assistant, native AWS, Google Cloud and Azure support, schema and data compare, task scheduling, single sign-on and support. Community has none of these.

points.title: Paid edition prices
points.text: Lite is USD 113 a year or USD 12 a month, Enterprise USD 255 a year or USD 26 a month, and Ultimate USD 510 a year with no monthly option. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Java comes in the box
points.text: Every download bundles OpenJDK, so there is nothing else to install. If you prefer your own Java 25 or newer, delete the `jre` folder.

points.title: Updates every two weeks
points.text: A new minor release ships about every two weeks and a major one each quarter. That is why the Windows listing keeps 197 versions; macOS lists only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.

points.title: System floor
points.text: Windows 10 or Server 2016 and later, x64 or Arm64, per user or for all users. macOS 11 or later, on Intel or Apple silicon. Linux builds exist on the project's site as .deb, RPM, tarball, Snap and Flatpak, but this site lists only Windows and macOS.
